name: Guild Swordsman
hp: 105 prototype; compare Sword Knight 100 and Royal Swordsman 130
kit: A plain, readable single-contact basic attacker. No automatic personal shield, spell, multi-target strike or board manipulation. Its role is a straightforward kill target around which true Guild teamwork operates.
look: Young human traveling adventurer in modest deep-blue/ochre Guild tabard over practical steel brigandine, one-handed short sword and compact leather backpack, simple identifiable Guild crest. Sturdy but not a Royal Swordsman clone: less formal armor, lively slightly unsure stance.
motion: Idle: planted shifting weight / tiny cape follow. Basic: step-and-slash with crisp left-facing impact, fixed sword in hand; hit/death reactions remain recognizable.

name: Guild Ranger
kit: Human Guild musketeer whose basic volley resolves as two separate shield-gated hits with modest per-hit damage.
look: Adult human marksman with round ears, indigo Guild field clothes, worn leather boots and a wood-stock musket. Keep the long gun distinct from the forearms and torso.
motion: Idle: hold the musket steady through a small breath. Basic: two short recoil and recovery beats follow the existing two-contact basic attack.

name: Guild Bulwark
hp: 150 fixed first-pass source HP (Royal Swordsman 130, Sword Knight 100); use normal global scaling; no extra shield by default
kit: User-directed TAUNT. For 3 future accepted moves, visually shatter/hide the weakness mini-gems on all OTHER living enemies, preserve their exact underlying weakness types, and block new player-origin enemy damage to them. Only Bulwark is a valid enemy damage target. Full source-specific gameplay/visual/Continue contract in SPECS/TAUNT_AND_INSTANT_HEAL.md. Start cooldown after expiration; no automatic retiming or companion stacking.
look: Bareheaded human with the compact proportions of the Dungeon Farmer, Pan Villager and approved Guild Swordsman and Ranger. Give him a large readable head, broad shoulders, short sturdy legs and a planted stance. Wear visible indigo Guild clothing with ochre trim and carry a large shield beside the torso. Keep the face and cloth visible above and alongside the shield.
motion: Idle: anchored shield-bearing stance. Basic: single weighty shield-side mace hit. Taunt special: brace and pound shield once, small Guild insignia pulse; UI facets shatter on allies with no board tile changes. Recovery returns to idle.

name: Elven Guild Chirurgeon
kit: User-directed INSTANT HEAL. Female elf in Guild equipment raises staff once and immediately restores 10 HP to one wounded OTHER ally (rounded/clamped normally), without any channel or delayed cast. No self-heal or shield. Five accepted moves between successful heals initially; skip healing if no wounded other ally. See SPECS/TAUNT_AND_INSTANT_HEAL.md.
look: Female **ELF** healer, clean pointed ears and calm focused face, short practical cream/blue travel robes with leather satchel, visible Guild brooch and a human-sized polished wood healing STAFF with small cool-green crystal. Outfit clearly Guild, not Forest Mender roots or a witch, priestess train, or armored knight.
motion: Idle: staff planted, subtle robe movement. Basic: tiny staff-side quick strike, low impact. Special: immediate upward staff gesture and small sparkle on one fixed ally at impact, not a lengthy chant or 2-move channel.

name: Nacre Duelist
kit: Basic-only agile duelist using one ordinary thrust. No bubble capture, forced flood, underwater poison, Fortified stack or fake immunity. Gives Court groups a Nacre fighter beside a Cantor or Marshal.
look: Small slim pearl-white / sea-violet courtier sea-folk with a thin shell rapier and formal-but-worn nacre sash. Distinct from Reef Spearman: pearl armor, ornamental narrow helm crest, no human court gown; readable oceanic silhouette.
motion: Idle: narrow ready stance. Basic: fast single lance jab then reset; no board mechanic.

name: Nacre Halberdier
hp: 1.1–1.3 × current Court normal median; avoid sustain-HP sponge
kit: Basic-only heavier attacker with an announced slow full-body halberd swing. No independent spell, buffs, bubble theft or extra oxygen tax. Provides alternative pressure to Needlefin and Nacre Duelist.
look: Broad shell-plated court guard, pale iridescent nacre armor with coral-violet textile and angular polearm with a shell-edged blade; shape larger than Duelist but consistent native pixel density.
motion: Idle: two-hand halberd anchor. Basic: controlled overhead draw and one broad heavy impact; no extra hit.

name: Elven Pathblade
kit: Basic-only one-hit melee attacker; no vine or root generation. Creates an alternative to Scout/Trailguard in existing Forest compositions.
look: Lean woodland elf with pale ear tips, short mossy travel cloak over antique tan tunic, curved short sword and leaf-shaped belt clasp. Handsome/charming but not noble; not another Elven Scout with a recolor.
motion: Idle: planted guard, tiny cloak motion. Basic: fast diagonal blade cut while feet remain grounded.

name: Orc Slinghunter
kit: Basic-only two-contact sling-stone sequence where engine supports two normal contacts; no rooting, vine production, Bloodrage or special marks. Adds melee/ranged variance to Orc Berserker/Drummer pairings.
look: Small olive-skinned forest orc based on the chosen O5 silhouette, with a red neck scarf, bare back and forked slingshot. Preserve the face, size, stocky stance and weapon of O5.
motion: Idle: settle the forked slingshot in the leading hand. Basic: draw, release, reload and release a second stone as two visible normal contacts. No lingering stones on the board.

name: Iceborn Axeman
kit: Basic-only slow, readable heavy axe impact. No automatic Frostbite, ice creation or temperature meter. Adds another grounded escort beside Reaver and Hearthkeeper, reducing Raider/Wolf repetition.
look: Stocky mountain human in thick blue-gray furs, sleeveless quilted vest, simple iron-and-wood two-handed axe, warm sash and heavy boots. Strong silhouette and warm face, no white-hair cliché or bright blue magical ice on every piece.
motion: Idle: axe handle grounded, fur moves subtly. Basic: slower overhead axe swing with one decisive hit and clear recovery.

name: Ore Ram
kit: Basic-only hefty worker/automaton with a longer visible windup before one heavy physical basic. It may receive existing Ore-Powered effects if compatible and documented, but must not create new machines, stone objects, drill infrastructure or a unique status.
look: Compact stout riveted mining automaton / horned ram-shaped ore hauler with curved front ram plate, warm rusty iron, muted slate stone and tiny amber core; industrial but charming, not steampunk gear rotation or a huge boss machine.
motion: Idle: piston compression and planted feet. Basic: winds up shoulder and one short forward ram, returns without root motion; separate from existing drills.
